DLSS/DLAA is the strongest historical inference because both the dated 2026-07-14 profile snapshot and the post-capture 2026-08-24 read request it, but an intervening selection or runtime capability fallback remains possible.

taauRuntimeContract.historyGate: Scene-color, dilated-depth, and dilated-SceneMV histories must all be valid, and TAAU must have been enabled on the preceding frame. Otherwise effective history weight is zero and firstFrame is one.
taauRuntimeContract.implementedSubset: The compatibility path now runs Dilation's recovered 3x3 reversed-Z winner scan, exact fourth-root SceneMV decode, previous-non-jittered-VP reprojection, previous dilated-depth/SceneMV lookup, and exact B/Z-lane flag repacking into persistent auxiliary histories. It also runs exact MaskDilation into an R8 current-frame resource: maximum packed B/Z over the center and four diagonals, then one iff the maximum is positive. A separate raw-lane copy of the same spatial winner remains the input to the partial beauty resolve until that resolve's packed-bit consumer is ported.
taauRuntimeContract.firstFrameSeedBoundary: The retail auxiliary texture allocation/clear payload is not recovered. The compatibility pass uses deterministic depth 0 and SceneMV (0.5,0.5,0,0) only while its explicit auxiliary-history-valid gate is false; the recovered managed history gate independently makes scene-color history weight zero on that first frame.
taauRuntimeContract.explicitBoundary: The packed B/Z-lane and current-mask tests in the ordinary resolve, the rest of the complete Quality-0 resolve policy, jitter, fast convergence, live IFix selection, and untouched constructor-seeded TAAU constant lanes remain unimplemented. The packed auxiliary SceneMV and mask are therefore generated but deliberately not beauty-consumed. The recovered managed base branch also does not prove live CharInfo IFix activation or override the saved DLSS/DLAA selection evidence.

temporalHistory.status: source boundary and auxiliary history schedule reproduced with partial ordinary Quality-0 TAA consumer
temporalHistory.behavior: While the explicit compatibility profile is requested but Endminf's effect clock is inactive, the camera preserves the latest scene color without resolving. The capture renders source-equivalent blank model-swap frame 1109 before selecting Endminf, allowing visible frame 1110 to consume that history instead of self-seeding.
knownPartialBoundary: the full recovered scene-color/dilated-depth/dilated-SceneMV history set is allocated, but only scene color and raw-lane spatially selected SceneMV feed the current partial beauty resolve
no exact complete TAA shader implementation
MaskDilation is generated but not beauty-consumed; packed-flag consumption, complete rejection, and the fast-converge path remain absent

exactAuxiliaryHistoryBeautyIsolated.interpretation: Canonical rerun after exact auxiliary-history persistence and flag repacking. The partial beauty resolve deliberately consumed a separate raw-lane spatial winner, so this validates non-regression and resource scheduling rather than a claimed quality gain.

clothBoundary.status: exact managed fallback not yet implementable
clothBoundary.blocker: Thirty-five proxy/prebuild arrays remain raw-preserved because their element strides and semantic types are unresolved. A simple spring/gravity substitute is not source-equivalent.
